mines.mine_notes: Open pit (oxide) gold mine; Stage 1 hard rock expansion commissioned with first gold poured December 15, 2025; commercial production declared January 16, 2026 (post year-end). FY2025 (100% basis): ore mined 8,436,661 t; ore milled 6,372,215 t @ 0.62 g/t Au; gold produced 110,014 oz, sold 109,084 oz (Orezone attributable 85% = 93,512 oz produced). Average realized price $3,444/oz; cash cost $1,586/oz sold; AISC $1,776/oz sold. Revenue $376.6M; earnings from mine operations $169.9M. 2026 guidance: 160,000-180,000 oz (100% basis).
mines.processing: CIL (oxide plant 5.9 Mtpa; new 4.4 Mtpa hard rock plant)

mines.mine_notes: Underground (West Mine) and open pit (F160) gold mine, Quebec. Acquired 100% from Hecla Mining Company on March 25, 2026 (post FY2025 year-end); not reflected in FY2025 results. Under Hecla, FY2025 production was 91,160 oz (5-year average 106,100 oz); 1.4 Mtpa conventional mill producing doré. Orezone plans to optimize operations, study underground ramp-up, and drill 80,000-100,000 m/year. No FY2025 production attributable to Orezone.

notes: FY2025 MD&A used (year ended December 31, 2025). Production = Orezone-attributable (85% of Bomboré 100%-basis figures reported in MD&A). P&P mineral reserves not disclosed in the MD&A (reserve fields null; refer to AIF). All amounts in USD.
